findings.claim: pkg/server/wire.go (lines 374-375) still registers anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore and binds AnonStore. ProvideAnonDBStore now requires an int64 parameter that no Wire provider supplies, and ProvideAnonymousDeviceService builds its own store instead of receiving AnonStore, so wire generation fails or the binding is dead.

verifier.reason: pkg/server/wire.go:374-375 still registers anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore and binds anonstore.AnonStore, while ProvideAnonDBStore in pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go:52 now requires an int64 deviceLimit parameter that no Wire provider supplies. ProvideAnonymousDeviceService in pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/impl.go:36-45 does not inject AnonStore and instead calls anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore(sqlStore, cfg.AnonymousDeviceLimit) directly at line 43, leaving the Wire registration dead in OSS and causing wire generation to fail if anything consumes AnonStore.

findings.claim: tagDeviceUI writes the device ID to localCache before calling CreateOrUpdateDevice and does not evict it on ErrDeviceLimitReached. Later requests from a rejected device hit the cache, TagDevice returns nil, and the device bypasses the limit until the cache entry expires.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/impl.go:87, tagDeviceUI caches the device key via localCache.SetDefault before calling CreateOrUpdateDevice at impl.go:93-95 and returns any error (including ErrDeviceLimitReached) without evicting the key. Subsequent requests from the rejected device hit localCache.Get at impl.go:83-85, causing TagDevice to return nil and Anonymous.Authenticate (pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/client.go:44-47) to allow access until the 29-minute cache TTL (impl.go:42) expires.
